title: A2FKP Focus Group on Thursday
summary: Please join us for a focus group to discuss the Association to Function Knowledge Portal on Thursday, November 10.
bodyHtml:
This coming Thursday, November 10, from 12-1pm EST, please join us for a focus group to give us your feedback on our newest Knowledge Portal (KP), the Association to Function Knowledge Portal (A2FKP; a2fkp.org). A2FKP covers the largest number of disease areas of all the KPs, and is unique among the KPs in offering a way for you to set a custom view of the portal to display only the traits and diseases that you’re most interested in. 

In this session we’ll review the new features in the A2FKP, and hope to get your feedback on all of them. Please take a look at the A2FKP beforehand and come prepared to share your thoughts! Joining instructions are below.
